card: ROLE: Colossal bio-mechanical entity resembling a cosmic whale; posed an imminent hostile threat to the planet Okhar in the recorded encounter.
ROLE: Directed internally by a servo-brain command node; no individual speech or personal volition is attested.
TRAIT: Outer hull resists direct weapons assault; external bombardment was not a viable attack vector in the recorded encounter.
TRAIT: Interior environment contains corrosive acids; passage through the creature's interior severely damaged Othon's lungs.
TRAIT: Scale sufficient to swallow a piloted metacraft whole.
TRAIT: Destruction of the internal servo-brain by simultaneous weapons discharge produced an explosion described as comparable to a supernova.

RELATIONSHIP: othon-von-salza (Othon von Salza): Othon deliberately allowed himself to be swallowed, piloted his metacraft to the servo-brain node, and destroyed it with simultaneous weapons fire; he suffered severe lung damage from the creature's internal corrosive acids in the process.
RELATIONSHIP: shabda-oud-witches (Shabda-Oud Witches): associated with the Shabda-Oud forces that threatened Okhar during this encounter.

INSTRUCTION: In the recorded encounter, external assault failed against this creature; the only confirmed defeat method was internal — entering the creature and destroying the servo-brain from within.
BOUNDARY: No speech, negotiation, or individual will is attested; do not portray this entity as capable of dialogue or autonomous motivation beyond its recorded hostile approach to Okhar.

BOUNDARY: This peer record is bounded to one confirmed destroyed unit; seven additional units were detected by ultra-radar approaching Okhar at the close of the encounter, but their subsequent actions and fates are not attested in this record.
